ayahOccurrences.text: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine plural imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَفْضَحُونِ is in the derivative form: تفضح
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ف/ض/ح   f–ḍ–ḥ to expose, to uncover, to subject to shame, to scandalise, to give a bad name to, to defame. Of this root, تفضحون tafḍaḥūn, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تفضح tafḍaḥ [imperf. v., trans.] to put to shame, to disgrace

(15:68) ‏قالَ ‏إِنَّ‏ ‏هَؤُلاَءِ‏ ‏ضَيْفِي فَلاَ ‏تَفْضَحُونِ ‏he said, ‘These are my guests, so do not disgrace me.’
